title: 第1098章 先祖之火择主而事第1097章 万火归宗殿
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 那霸道的火焰本源，被他恐怖的身体亲和力轻易接纳、融合。
他对火焰的掌控力，特别是对天地间至阳火焰的亲和度，正在以一种令人瞠目结舌的速度飙升！
雪姒疏站在池边，看着池中那道如鱼得水的身影，嘴角的笑意怎么也压不下去。
她对姚德龙的圣体早有认知，但亲眼见到他如此轻松写意地“泡”在化生池中，依旧感到心潮澎湃。
约莫半个时辰后，当涂山战作为第三名通过万火归宗殿考验的人，
带着疲惫与一丝兴奋踏入此地时，看到的就是这样一幕：
姚德龙惬意地在化生池中闭目养神，周身流淌着比池水更加纯粹凝练的金红火焰，
气息深邃而磅礴，仿佛与整个火池融为了一体！
“这……姚姑爷他……”涂山战的下巴差点掉在地上。
紧接着，雪姒疏也踏入化生池。她身负寒冰天狐血脉，与极致之火本是相克，此关对她而言凶险极大。
她盘膝坐于火液之中，周身涌起月白色的冰晶寒气，与那灼热火液进行着激烈的对抗与融合。
寒霜与火焰在她身上交织、碰撞，发出滋滋的声响，
她的脸色也在红白之间不断转换，显然承受着巨大的痛苦与压力，但根基深厚，尚能支撑。
随后，保守派的涂山焱、涂山风也带着惊魂未定的涂山冥等人陆续赶到。
当他们看到已经在池中泡得无比舒服、甚至气息还在不断增强的姚德龙时，
脸上的表情精彩纷呈，嫉妒、惊骇、无力、茫然……如同打翻了五味瓶。
“他…他真的是人族吗？”涂山风看着池中那道身影，声音干涩地喃喃自语。
涂山冥更是把头深深埋下，不敢再看。
几人也只能硬着头皮，各自承受着化生池的恐怖洗礼。一时间，池中景象各异：
雪姒疏寒火交织，苦苦支撑；涂山战咬紧牙关，浑身赤红；
涂山焱、涂山风等人更是惨叫连连，皮肤焦黑，仿佛随时会被焚化……
唯有一人例外。
姚德龙缓缓睁开眼，眼眸深处仿佛有两轮金色太阳在燃烧。
他感受着体内更加精纯磅礴的大日圣力，以及对火焰那近乎本能的掌控感，满意地呼出一口灼热的气息。
化生池的洗礼，对他而言，不过是给这具早已登峰造极的圣体，再添了一把薪柴罢了。
化生池的洗礼终于结束，那一名高阶妖王境的涂山子弟，浑身焦黑，气息萎靡，
如同从地狱边缘爬回来，再看向那通往更深处第七重考验的火海漩涡时，眼中只剩下深深的恐惧和无力。
他们挣扎着爬起来，声音嘶哑：“圣…圣女，姑爷…我等…无力再闯，甘愿在此等候禁地关闭……”
涂山冥，看着同伴的惨状，再想想自己燃魂谷的遭遇和即将面对的未知凶险，心中那点不甘也被彻底浇灭。
涂山冥更是羞愧难当，低着头道：“我也留下。”
机缘虽好，也要有命拿。
最终，只剩下六人——姚德龙、雪姒疏、涂山战、涂山风、涂山焱，以及另一位实力不俗的初阶妖皇涂山岩。
六人踏入通往第七重的火焰门户，眼前的景象瞬间让他们心神剧震！
这是一片无边无际、燃烧着亿万朵各色火焰的浩瀚海洋！
content_en:
那霸道的火焰本源，被他恐怖的身体亲和力轻易接纳、融合。
His control over flames, especially his affinity for the Sun Flame between heaven and earth, is soaring at a jaw-dropping speed!
Xue Sishu stood by the pool, looking at the figure in the pool who was as comfortable as a fish in water, the smile on her lips could not be suppressed.
She had known about Yao Delong's holy body for a long time, but seeing him "soaking" in the transmutation pool so easily and freely with her own eyes still made her heart surge.
约莫半个时辰后，当涂山战作为第三名通过万火归宗殿考验的人，
When I stepped into this place with a sense of exhaustion and a bit of excitement, I saw this scene:
Yao Delong closed his eyes and rested his mind comfortably in the Huasheng Pond, with a golden-red flame that was more pure and concise than the water flowing around his body.
The breath is deep and majestic, as if it is integrated with the entire fire pool!
"This...Uncle Yao..." Tu Shanzhan's jaw almost dropped to the ground.
Immediately afterwards, Xuesi Shu also stepped into the Huasheng Pond.她身负寒冰天狐血脉，与极致之火本是相克，此关对她而言凶险极大。
She sat cross-legged in the fire liquid, and the moon-white ice crystal cold air surged around her body, fiercely confronting and merging with the scorching fire liquid.
Frost and flames intertwined and collided on her body, making a sizzling sound.
Her complexion also kept changing between red and white. She was obviously suffering from tremendous pain and pressure, but her foundation was deep and she could still support it.
Later, conservative Tu Shanyan and Tu Shanfeng arrived one after another with Tu Shanming and others who were still in shock.
当他们看到已经在池中泡得无比舒服、甚至气息还在不断增强的姚德龙时，
The expressions on his face were various, including jealousy, horror, weakness, confusion... as if he had knocked over a five-flavor bottle.
"He...is he really a human?" Tu Shanfeng looked at the figure in the pool and muttered to himself in a dry voice.
Tu Shanming even buried his head deeply, not daring to look any further.
Several people could only bite the bullet and endure the horrific baptism of the Huasheng Pond. For a time, the scene in the pool was different:
Snow Sis is intertwined with cold and fire, struggling to hold on; Tu Shanzhan grits his teeth and is red all over;
Tu Shanyan, Tu Shanfeng and others screamed in agony, their skins were charred black, as if they would be incinerated at any time...
There is only one exception.
Yao Delong slowly opened his eyes, and there seemed to be two golden suns burning deep in his eyes.
He felt the more pure and majestic Holy Power of the Great Sun in his body, as well as his almost instinctive control over the flames, and exhaled a hot breath of satisfaction.
For him, the baptism in the Huasheng Pond was nothing more than adding a handful of firewood to the holy body that had already reached its peak.
The baptism in the Huasheng Pond finally ended. The disciple of Tushan, who was in the high-level Demon King realm, was scorched black and his breath was sluggish.
It's like crawling back from the edge of hell, and when you look at the whirlpool of fire that leads to the deeper seventh test, there is only deep fear and powerlessness in your eyes.
They struggled to get up, their voices hoarse: "Holy... saintly girl, uncle... I am... unable to break in anymore, and I am willing to wait here for the forbidden area to be closed..."
Tu Shanming, looking at the tragic situation of his companions, and then thinking about his experience in Burning Soul Valley and the unknown dangers he was about to face, the unwillingness in his heart was completely extinguished.
Tu Shanming was even more embarrassed, lowered his head and said: "I will stay too."
Although the opportunity is good, you must take it with your life.
In the end, there were only six people left - Yao Delong, Xue Sishu, Tu Shanzhan, Tu Shanfeng, Tu Shanyan, and Tu Shanyan, another junior demon king with considerable strength.
The six people stepped into the flame portal leading to the seventh level, and the sight in front of them instantly shocked them!
This is a boundless vast ocean burning with billions of flames of various colors!
